title: pyrethrum atkinsonii
intro: Pyrethrum atkinsonii, commonly known as the Himalayan Chrysanthemum or Tickseed Chrysanthemum, is a flowering plant species native to the Himalayan region. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Pyrethrum atkinsonii include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and pyrethrins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
